observations.prerequisites: Requires Contact! completion and base levels 62 Agility, 55 Crafting and 55 Firemaking. No protection-prayer block outside the Head Menaphite Guard encounter.
observations.ullek: Message and Menaphite guard; Ullek furnace coal, well tablet, ritual chest passcode 1118513, iron bar emblem, scarab dial, two mages, timed levers, random urn riddle, rusty key and Champion of Scabaras.
observations.cure_and_finale: Nardah crocodile crossing requires meat, Lily of the Elid cure chemistry and crate delivery. Necropolis Osman confrontation and Menaphite Akh boss lead to Sophanem completion.
observations.reward: Pinned helper records 2 QP, 50,000 Agility XP, keris partisan, circlet of water and Tombs of Amascut access. AKP unlocks on initial necropolis exploration; ring routes are staff and agility gated.
observations.transport: Walk transitions from the current Sophanem, Nardah and Zanaris nodes; dungeon exits modeled in both directions. Jaltevas sceptre activation is not yet usable without a verified sceptre supplier.

pending_reviews: Verify Scabaras dungeon instance tiles, trap timings, exit behaviour and route through the eastern cliffs in-game.
The time-limited two-lever puzzle and randomized urn order are planned successes; the current transition contract cannot enforce a maximum interval or dynamic puzzle permutation.
Head Menaphite Guard, Scarab Mage, Champion and Akh encounters omit variable food, antipoison, prayer and incidental combat XP. Validate equipment and risk with gameplay.
Confirm the circlet's initial charged state and whether Keris is upgraded or returned independently upon completion; inventory-full fallback claims were not modeled.
Jaltevas Pharaoh's sceptre teleport was observed but remains unmodeled until a legitimate sceptre acquisition and charge model exists.
Verify AKP exact landing coordinates, path from the necropolis, quest tool respawns, Nardah meat price, GE bundle cost and all stage durations.
